results.finding: sections, unit counts and unit forms match the spec

All eleven unit summaries state the controlling idea of the aligned spec paragraph (p01-p11); the callout is page format. For p09 the outliner read 'first three product thinking, fourth system design', narrower than the spec's 'the four steps are product thinking, and the fourth is also the decision-right lever', but the same idea (the steps carry the two lenses).

Introduction ¶3 (thesis / roadmap): both belong to p03, whose controlling idea includes the four chapters answering four questions and which is the spec's roadmap placement. Chapters in this part ¶2 (four answers and so-what / reading advice and hand-off): both belong to p11, whose controlling idea includes the first chapter, with the takeaway declared in the conclusion.
p04-p07 serve P3-1 to P3-4 as declared; p08 and p09 serve P3-4; introduction and conclusion units state or collect the thesis. No unit is off-thesis.

Each spec evidence item is present and its point stated: Corvane scenario (p01, p02), the two missing reasons (p04), what an outcome with a vision supplies (p05), Build What Matters named as the source of the terms (p06), the dependency reasoning (p07), 'each level decides where it has the information' (p08), chapter 2 and the decision right (p09). Both lists have a lead-in sentence; the chapter list is interpreted by the paragraph after it.

All ten transition_in boundaries read as declared: p02 'You have probably worked to a roadmap like this one'; p03 'Part III's answer is that a roadmap is for outcomes'; section 1 'The reason a delivered roadmap can change nothing lies in what a request is'; p05 'What supplies both reasons is...'; section 2 'Part III gets from a list of requests to an outcome with a vision behind it... in four steps'; p07 'depend on each other in one direction'; p08 'The last step holds the conflict...'; p09 'The four steps also carry the two lenses'; conclusion 'Each of the four chapters answers one question' (thin: it carries the steps only through 'one per chapter' earlier, acceptable); p11 'The four chapters put four answers in the place of one list'.

results.finding: Opens on the Corvane scenario (puzzling_scenario as specified), bridges through the reader's own roadmap to the question, then states thesis and roadmap. No dictionary opening, throat-clearing or announcement-only lead.
The closing does not merely restate: it reads Corvane's list against the four answers, states the change for leaders and teams, and hands off. No new argument, no apology, no bare summary.

Synthesis present ('four answers in the place of one list: what to aim at, in which order, by when and with how much certainty, and who chooses the solution'); so-what present nearly verbatim (leader stops approving feature lists; team answers for a result); takeaway and hand-off to outcomes-over-output present.
'Corvane's list of forty-one promises said what would ship, for whom and when, and it gave none of the four' reads the opening list against the four questions, as the spec's callback requires.

The cold reader predicted both roadmap promises in order: why a list of requests cannot steer, then the four steps that replace it, then four chapters answering the four questions; also the thesis and the Corvane evidence.

The cold reader named the four chapters' subjects in reading order: Outcomes over Output; Vision and Product Strategy; Roadmaps and Horizons; Discovery, Delivery and Empowered Teams, each with its question.
